visual_concept: Illustrate the latency ladder: Batch → Micro‑batch → Streaming, showing data flow direction and relative timing.
image_prompt: Flat 2D technical vector diagram, orthographic view, deep navy background (#050B14). Three centered horizontal pipelines stacked vertically: top wide batch pipeline with a thick cool‑grey line and a long bright cyan arrow, middle micro‑batch pipeline with a medium cool‑grey line and a shorter bright cyan arrow, bottom thin streaming pipeline with a thin cool‑grey line and a very short bright cyan arrow. Each pipeline consists of a database cylinder, a processing node, and a storage block, connected by thin cool‑grey infrastructure lines. Use white (#FFFFFF) for structural contrast. High negative space (~60%). No text, no labels, no numbers, no glow, no 3D, no people, no decorative icons.
negative_prompt: text, labels, numbers, code snippets, UI screenshots, excessive glow, cyberpunk, 3D renders, realistic textures, photorealistic people, rainbow colors, floating icons, duplicate nodes, arbitrary arrows, decorative elements, generic corporate stock graphics
accessibility_alt_text: A flat 2D diagram showing three stacked data pipelines: a wide batch pipeline with a long horizontal arrow, a narrower micro‑batch pipeline with a shorter arrow, and a thin streaming pipeline with a very short arrow, all flowing from left to right.
